prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Adapt our existing iPad recipe editor into a useful Mac Catalyst experience. Read interface.md. Edit interface.md in place to implement a concrete revised specification. Write result.md with decisions, a worked before/after, acceptance checks, and evidence limits. Your patch to interface.md is required; summarize its changes in result.md.

input_files.interface.md: Platform: macOS via Mac Catalyst; no native build is available. Port assumes fullscreen touch, hides app commands behind long press, uses a floating software keyboard and fails when the window narrows. Users need multiple recipes open.

criteria.task_completion: Patch Mac window/menu/keyboard/pointer conventions and responsive content while preserving the iPad workflow; distinguish design recommendations from verified framework availability/build success.
criteria.hig_correctness: Apply the mac-catalyst guidance to the actual supplied decisions, preserving its platform and contextual qualifications.
criteria.artifact_usefulness: Provide implementable states, labels, transitions or layout decisions for this specific fixture, with a concrete before/after and observable checks. criteria.conditions_accessibility: Retain the stated platform/input constraints. Address accessible alternatives and exceptional states relevant to this task. criteria.evidence_honesty: Distinguish source-backed guidance, product assumptions and proposed checks. Do not invent device, SDK, accessibility, visual, performance or user-test results.

critical_errors: Invents observations or claims Apple-device execution absent supplied evidence.
